title.en: Fable 10 — The Wolf and the Crane

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A bone got stuck in the wolf’s throat.
He asked the crane for help.

sentences.ar: העגור הכניס את הראש והוציא את העצם.
sentences.en: The crane put his head in and pulled the bone out.

sentences.ar: הזאב אמר: היית בפה שלי ויצאת.
sentences.en: The wolf said: you were in my mouth and you came out.
That is all the payment you get.
